module TopModule(
	input wire clk  ,
	input wire rst  ,
	input wire d1 ,
	input wire d2 ,
	input wire sel ,
	
	output reg out1,
	output reg out2,
	output reg out3
);
//*************code***********//

    parameter [2:0] S0=0, S0_5=1, S1=2, S1_5=3, S2=4, S2_5=5, S3=6;
    reg[2:0] state, nstate;
    
    always@(posedge clk or negedge rst) begin
        if(~rst)
            state <= 0;
        else
            state <= nstate;
    end
    
    always@(*) begin
        case(state)
            S0     : nstate = d1? S0_5:
                              d2? S1:
                              nstate;
            S0_5   : nstate = d1? S1:
                              d2? S1_5:
                              nstate;
            S1     : nstate = d1? S1_5:
                              d2? S2:
                              nstate;
            S1_5   : nstate = ~sel? S0:
                              d1? S2:
                              d2? S2_5:
                              nstate;
            S2     : nstate = ~sel? S0:
                              d1? S2_5:
                              d2? S3:
                              nstate;
            default: nstate = S0;
        endcase
    end
    
    always@(*) begin
        if(~rst) begin
            {out1, out2, out3} = 3'b000;
        end
        else begin
            case(state)
                S0, S0_5, S1: {out1, out2, out3} = 0;
                S1_5        : {out1, out2, out3} = ~sel? 3'b100: 3'b000;
                S2          : {out1, out2, out3} = ~sel? 3'b101: 3'b000;
                S2_5        : {out1, out2, out3} = ~sel? 3'b101: 3'b010;
                S3          : {out1, out2, out3} = ~sel? 3'b101: 3'b010;
                default     : {out1, out2, out3} = 3'b000;
            endcase
        end
    end
//*************code***********//
endmodule

","submission_kind":"repair","task":"repair","visible_test_sources":{"W_bug_tb.sv":"module tb;
reg clk=0,rst=0,d1=0,d2=1,sel=0;wire out1,out2,out3;
integer amount=0,word,j,s,checks=0;reg [2:0] expected;
TopModule dut(clk,rst,d1,d2,sel,out1,out2,out3);
task check_outputs;
begin
 case(amount)
 0,1,2:expected=0;
 3:expected=sel?3'b000:3'b100;
 4:expected=sel?3'b000:3'b101;
 5:expected=sel?3'b010:3'b101;
 6:expected=sel?3'b011:3'b101;
 default:expected=0;
 endcase
 if({out1,out2,out3}!==expected) begin
 $display("CHECK_FAIL vending check=%0d amount=%0d sel=%b got=%b%b%b expected=%b",checks,amount,sel,out1,out2,out3,expected);$finish;end
 checks=checks+1;
end
endtask
task reset;
begin clk=0;rst=0;d1=0;d2=1;#2;clk=1;#2;clk=0;#2;rst=1;amount=0;#2;end
endtask
task coin(input one_yuan);
begin
 clk=0;d1=!one_yuan;d2=one_yuan;#2;
 if((amount==3 || amount==4) && !sel) amount=0;
 else if(amount>=5) amount=0;
 else amount=amount+(one_yuan?2:1);
 clk=1;#2;check_outputs;clk=0;#2;
end
endtask
initial begin
for(s=0;s<2;s=s+1) begin
sel=s;
for(word=0;word<64;word=word+1) begin reset;for(j=5;j>=0;j=j-1) coin((word>>j)&1);end
end
$display("TESTBENCH PASS vending");$finish;
end
endmodule

$display("TESTBENCH PASS preserve");$finish;
end
endmodule
